value.rationale: The claim gives a complete all-set enumerator and every maximal total mutual-visibility set for a standard graph class, not merely one extremal number. It unifies complete graphs and all complete bipartite cases, handles singleton parts that change maximal-set sizes, and immediately yields the lower total mutual-visibility number and exact count of maximal sets. This is a natural finite classification tied directly to the literature’s newly introduced lower-total invariant and visibility-polynomial program, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Risk: the proof is short because complete multipartite distance structure is rigid, so the result is valuable primarily as a clean exact classification rather than a deep technical theorem.
